title: Infrastructure Weekly Update - 2026-03-09
body:
Summary:
- Week: 2026-03-02 to 2026-03-09 (reporting week).
- Focus: GPU fleet health, region capacity headroom, short-term procurement, and autoscaler tuning for Dedicated pools.

Highlights:
- Overall fleet healthy. Average GPU utilization (production-serving pools) across regions: 42%.
- H100 reservation for Dedicated customers increased by 10% in us-east4 to support two new enterprise rollouts.
- Autoscaler tuning PR merged (see linked PR). Initial synthetic load tests show 12% lower cold-starts for large-model jobs.

Incidents / Reliability:
- 2026-03-05 08:12 UTC: Partial throughput degradation in us-west1 (NAT gateway saturation -> increased latency for a subset of requests). Impact: ~6% of requests experienced >500ms additional latency for 18 minutes.
  - Mitigation: Traffic shifted to us-east4 and eu-west1 via smart routing; NAT gateway replaced and capacity increased.
  - Postmortem draft created: JIRA-INFRA-1024 (linked). Action: add NAT saturation alert and automated failover runbook.

Capacity & Regions:
- Inventory (approx): total GPUs: 3,840 (A100: 2,000, H100: 1,200, T4/V100 for smaller pools: 640).
- Region breakdown (approx available GPUs after reservations):
  - us-west1: 920 (mixed; A100 heavy)
  - us-east4: 1,050 (increased H100 commit this week)
  - eu-west1: 840 (balancing for EU customers)
  - ap-southeast1: 300 (spot/burst capacity)
- Headroom target: 20% spare capacity for peak bursts. Current measured headroom: ~18% (slightly under target due to two Dedicated commits).
- Near-term plan: short-term H100 spot leases for ap-southeast1 to avoid capacity shortfall during next 6-week marketing push in APAC. Procurement team engaged.

Capacity Planning Notes / Forecast:
- Demand signal: production token throughput growth ~14% QoQ. Dedicated reserved commitments expected to add 6% sustained demand over next quarter.
- If current growth continues, projected headroom will drop below 10% by late April. Options being evaluated: additional reserved procurement, increased cross-region failover, and expanding CPU-only prewarm pools to reduce GPU pressure for small prompts.

Autoscaling & Runtime Tuning:
- Autoscaler tuning (PR merged) reduces per-request cold-start by ~12% on large-model splits. Still seeing spikes when many canaries launch simultaneously.
- Action: implement staggered canary windows for rollouts, and backpressure at router level when concurrent canaries > N (TBD).

Cost & Economics:
- H100 utilization improving; per-token cost down ~8% vs last month due to better batching configs and KV cache sharing.
- Spot usage in ap-southeast1 accounted for 9% of total GPU hours; recommend increasing spot tolerance for non-latency-sensitive workloads.

Standup / Meeting Notes (daily log highlights):
- Mon 2026-03-02: Quick sync on incident follow-ups (Priya, Ethan, Maya). Agreed to add NAT alerts.
- Tue 2026-03-03: Capacity planning deep-dive; finance to confirm capital availability for spot H100 leases (Carlos).
- Wed 2026-03-04: Autoscaler performance review; merged tuning PR after QA.
- Thu 2026-03-05: Incident response and routing adjustment; follow-up postmortem owner assigned (Zoe).
- Fri 2026-03-06: Dedicated customer onboarding prep; finalize H100 reservation for us-east4.
- Mon 2026-03-09: Weekly capacity planning meeting; agreed on short-term spot approach and prioritized procurement requests.

Action Items (owners):
- Priya: finalize spot H100 lease proposal and send to finance by 2026-03-12.
- Ethan: implement NAT gateway saturation alert + automated failover runbook (JIRA-INFRA-1051). ETA 2026-03-16.
- Maya: follow up with procurement on H100 spot availability in ap-southeast1; update by 2026-03-11.
- Carlos: confirm budget/commit approvals for 6-week burst capacity; update by next planning sync.
- Zoe: complete postmortem write-up for 2026-03-05 incident and publish to confluence.

Open Questions / Blockers:
- Procurement lead needs vendor confirmation on short-term H100 availability in APAC — blocker for immediate burst plan.
- Autoscaler still needs a safe throttling mechanism for simultaneous canary launches across regions. Design proposal due 2026-03-18.

Notes to self / informal:
- Consider adding weekly GPU headroom chart to this doc next week (simple table).
- Remind teams to tag Dedicated jobs with "latency-sensitive" so autoscaler can treat them differently.

Relevant links and refs: see linked_artifacts above.

Next meeting: Weekly capacity planning sync on 2026-03-16 17:00 UTC.

-- Priya
(internal infra lead)
